purpose: Teach: 立ち入り/来客/注釈/痕跡/痕/に当たる/成っ/時として

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 立ち入りカード、リーダー、最新型に。
lines.en: Access cards, readers—upgrade to the latest model.
lines.style: Clipped, efficient. Enunciation crisp on the directives. No warmth, all business. The tone of someone delegating routine but important tasks without ceremony.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。来客の動線、見直しました。
lines.en: Yes. I've reviewed the guest flow paths.
lines.style: Affirming but measured. Quick uptake—no hesitation, no embellishment. The response of someone trained to receive direction and execute cleanly.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 契約書の注釈、英語化も検討する。
lines.en: We should consider English translations for the contract annotations too.
lines.style: Thoughtful shift in tone. Slightly softer than the first line—this is planning ahead, not barking orders. Deliberate pace on the compound idea.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。痕跡を残さない不正、警戒します。
lines.en: Yes. I'll watch for misconduct that doesn't leave obvious traces.
lines.style: Steady, slightly heavier. The weight of the actual implication settles in on this line. Not anxious—professional caution. Quiet understanding.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 過去事案の痕、社内文書、保存ね。
lines.en: Keep all internal documents related to past incidents on file.
lines.style: Firm, no question in it. Back to directional mode. Each phrase gets equal weight. The certainty of someone who has learned what matters.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。年度替わりに当たる時期、注意します。
lines.en: Yes. I'll be careful around fiscal year transitions—that's when things slip through.
lines.style: Acknowledgment with a note of weariness underneath. He knows this already, has learned it. Slight trailing tone—not complaint, but the acknowledgment of someone who understands the recurring pattern.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.en: The IT budget increase came through.
lines.style: Genuinely warm break in the conversation. Lighter attack. The first moment of good news—delivered plainly but with quiet satisfaction. A small exhale.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。時として、想定外の対応も必要です。
lines.en: Yes. Sometimes we'll need to be ready for things we didn't expect.
lines.style: Measured, slightly philosophical close. Not urgent. The voice of someone settling in, knowing there's always more to prepare for. Almost a nod of agreement.
